title: Palisade 3D model library
coordinates: GLB: right-handed, Y up; character art faces +Z; units meters. Tracer origin is at the nose, forward +X; kill effects use centered origins.
scope: 148 rigged characters with editable stylized animation sets, modular slots and bone-following sockets. 52 fitted headgear items plus 6 special-head variants. Tracer, kill-effect and environment art is preserved from v2; runtime effects and gameplay integration remain separate.

assets.name: Arsonist
assets.description: He aims, then lobs a chain of napalm down the line. It burns for 10 seconds and eats through metal faster than normal fire.

assets.name: Blue Butcher
assets.description: His sword throws a glowing blue arc that goes straight through brick walls and breaks them. A teal lane shows where it goes: get out of it.

assets.name: Breacher
assets.description: Runs a satchel charge up to a wall and blows it open.

assets.name: Bulldozer
assets.description: No more digging. He charges at you fast down a marked lane. When he hits a wall he breaks it, and he's dazed for a few seconds.

assets.name: Butcher
assets.description: A blade and a temper. A red lane means he is about to charge down it: get out of the lane.

assets.name: Demolisher
assets.description: He fires slow rockets. A red line shows where the next one goes: step out of it.

assets.name: Supreme Destroyer
assets.description: Back rockets, a fire-and-lightning gun, poison gas and mines. Below 40% he calls an orbital cannon. Every attack is marked first: read it and move.

assets.name: Ferryman
assets.description: He works the river from a raft. A chain line means a harpoon: it drags whoever it hits (or a wall) toward the water. He lands boarding crews on the banks.

assets.name: Firebrand
assets.description: Throws fire bottles at wooden walls, or at people close by. The glass bursts into burning ground and sets wood alight.

assets.name: Foreman
assets.description: He drills under the ground where bullets can't reach. A dust trail and a rumble show where he's going: when it stops, he bursts up through whatever is on top.

assets.name: Grenadier
assets.description: Lobs grenades over your walls at you and your defenses.

assets.name: Harbinger
assets.description: He fires missiles from his boat in a high arc. Each one shows a red ring where it lands: keep moving and it misses.

assets.name: Field Medic
assets.description: Hangs back behind other raiders and patches up everyone near him every 1.6 s. Take him out first.

assets.name: Pumpkin Butcher
assets.description: Seasonal butcher encounter: same charge and blade attacks, carved pumpkin head and ember sword.

assets.name: Rifleman
assets.description: The backbone of every raid. Walks the path and shoots whoever is closest.

assets.name: Rime Colossus
assets.description: Cracking ice marks a huge rupture. Step clear. His marked dash leaves poisoned frost that slows everyone crossing it.

assets.name: Shieldbearer
assets.description: Turns a riot shield toward whoever is shooting. Rounds from the front spark off: flank him, or use Armor Piercing or explosives.

assets.name: Spotter
assets.description: Sits back 6 to 9 tiles and marks a soldier with a red laser. Riflemen aim far better at whoever is marked.

assets.name: Stormcaller
assets.description: A lightning rifle that jumps between people. A blue line means a shot is coming: break line of sight, and spread out.

assets.name: Tempest
assets.description: Two lightning shots at once, side by side. Two blue lines show them coming. Get caught by both and it hurts twice as much.

assets.name: Frostbound Butcher
assets.description: A lunging ice arc and a marked frost rupture. Step sideways after his charge.

assets.name: Icebound Ferryman
assets.description: Harpoons and boarding crews guard the river. A marked frost rupture forces you off his landing zone.

assets.name: Permafrost Foreman
assets.description: A fast marked charge and frost ruptures. Bait him into a wall to leave him dazed.

assets.name: Money Explosion
